stemMarkdown: The average of 20 observations was calculated as 60, but one observation was wrongly read as 43 instead of the correct value 53. What is the correct average? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The recorded total was $20 \times 60 = 1200$. Correcting the single entry changes it by $53 - 43 = 10$, giving a true total of $1210$. The correct average is $\dfrac{1210}{20} = 60.5$.
